inventoryMapping.description: The first pair has two separated vertical thick plates: positive on the left, negative on the right. +|q| is above/left, -|q| above/right and C_1 is below the pair. Neither q has a subscript.
The second pair is to the right, also left positive and right negative; it has +|q| and -|q| above and C_2 below. Both groups remain distinct.

A horizontal left lead ends at the first positive plate, with U_1 below it. A horizontal right lead leaves the second negative plate, with U_3 below it. No open circles or filled node dots are drawn at their outer ends.

A single straight horizontal wire directly connects the first negative plate to the second positive plate. U_2 is printed below this middle wire. It has no branch, ground, battery or extra terminal. The connected negative and positive plates belong to the same isolated intermediate conductor group, not two separately grounded nodes. Initial neutrality and no leakage are contextual conditions, not new graphical labels.
No q subscripts, third capacitor, junction dots, external intermediate branch, voltage-equality mark, current arrow, ground, battery, equation, dimensions or caption is printed.

interpretation.interpretationFromFrozenProse: Equal magnitudes in the depicted charge labels are conditional on this intermediate conductor group initially having zero net charge and not leaking externally. Do not claim every arbitrary series circuit has equal voltage division.

modernRegularization: One clean horizontal chain with evenly drawn plate glyphs and labels enlarged to at least 16 px at all supplied actual media widths. Equal glyph size is schematic and does not claim equal capacitance or equal voltage. No new neutral-node label or charge-conservation equation is added.
endpointMappingDecision: Plate strokes are split at shared hidden contact anchors. Every wire and plate half has a connects assertion. Native inventory maps visible strokes/text/dots, not invisible construction points; author graph checks derive and verify the full electrical components. Gap distances are uncalibrated layout clearances, not source measurements.
